about: The Campaign Shelf on ww2dispatches.com/campaign-series (Site Revamp doc). One entry per volume, in volume order. A volume whose folder campaign-series/<id>/ holds day records is built as a live volume page; the others show a stamped cover and the note. Edit by hand; renderer/site_pages.py reads it. runYear is the year the series posts in (a day's run date is its historical day and month in runYear, stepping up a year after December, unless the day record has a postDate). cover is a photo in this repo; cloth is the clothbound color; status: live comes on its own from day records; planned (decided, not yet built), prep (being built), proposed (an idea). Volumes are numbered in posting order; months whose pick is still undecided join once decided. Spine size follows the series length (renderer/site_pages.py, spine_size): longer series are thicker and a little taller; a volume with no length yet gets the middle size.

volumes.title: Pearl Harbor
volumes.intro: Twelve days to war, told as they happened.
volumes.blurb: From the morning Japan's carriers slip out of the Kurils to the midget submarines creeping toward Oahu in the dark.

volumes.title: The Bulge
volumes.blurb: Hitler's last gamble in the West, from the dawn barrage in the Ardennes to the American armies closing on Houffalize.
volumes.note: First dispatch 16 Dec 2026 at 6:30 a.m. Mountain. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Anzio
volumes.blurb: Allied troops land behind the German line in Italy, then must hold a narrow beachhead under the guns.
volumes.note: Begins with the 22 January 1944 landing, posting from 22 Jan 2027. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Remagen
volumes.blurb: An American patrol finds a bridge over the Rhine still standing, and the army races to hold it.
volumes.note: Posts in March 2027 on the real dates. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Okinawa
volumes.blurb: The last great battle of the Pacific, and the radar picket destroyers that stood in the path of the kamikazes.
volumes.note: Posts in spring 2027 on the real dates. Days appear here as they post.
